2609.05141.title: SciDocBench: A Workflow-Centered Benchmark and Data Pipeline for Scientific Document Understanding
2609.05141.paper_summary: Scientific papers require models to reason jointly over text, equations, figures, tables, code, and datasets while preserving the provenance of supporting evidence. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear whether multimodal models can support realistic scientific-reading workflows. We introduce SciDocBench, a workflow-centered benchmark for scientific document understanding. It contains 124 expert-authored and difficulty-screened questions organized into seven research-assistant capability groups and 19 subtasks across five scientific domains. Each question is instantiated under four matched conditions combining English or Chinese questions with all-images-first or interleaved document representations, yielding 496 evaluation instances for controlled analysis. The strongest evaluated system achieves only 62.6/100, with pronounced weaknesses in document perception, evidence grounding, verification, and cross-document reasoning. To translate these diagnostics into scalable training signals, we introduce SciDocIR, a typed evidence-graph representation that preserves scientific document objects, layout and cross-reference relations, and provenance. Building on SciDocIR, we construct SciDocDataset, comprising approximately 15K supervised fine-tuning samples and 8K reinforcement-learning samples across 14 verifiable subtasks. Together, SciDocBench, SciDocIR, and SciDocDataset form an evaluation-to-training framework for diagnosing and improving scientific-document assistants. The project page is available at https://github.com/InternLM/SciDocBench.
2609.05141.paper_summary_zh: 科學論文需要模型能夠對文本、方程式、圖形、表格、代碼和數據集進行聯合推理，同時保留支持證據的來源。現有基準通常孤立地評估這些能力，尚不清楚多模態模型是否能支持現實的科學閱讀工作流程。我們介紹了 SciDocBench，一個以工作流程為中心的科學文檔理解基準。它包含 124 個專家撰寫和難度篩選的問題，這些問題被組織成七個研究助理能力組和五個科學領域中的 19 個子任務。每個問題在四個匹配條件下實例化，將英語或中文問題與全圖像優先或交錯文檔表示結合，產生 496 個控制分析的評估實例。最強的評估系統僅達到 62.6/100，在文檔感知、證據基礎、驗證和跨文檔推理方面存在明顯的弱點。為了將這些診斷轉化為可擴展的訓練信號，我們介紹了 SciDocIR，一種類型化的證據圖表示，保留科學文檔對象、佈局和交叉引用關係及來源。基於 SciDocIR，我們構建了 SciDocDataset，包含約 15K 個監督微調樣本和 8K 個強化學習樣本，涵蓋 14 個可驗證的子任務。總之，SciDocBench、SciDocIR 和 SciDocDataset 形成了一個評估到訓練的框架，用於診斷和改進科學文檔助手。項目頁面可在 https://github.com/InternLM/SciDocBench 獲得。
